Name: House of Self
Meaning: The 1st House governs your outward personality, how others perceive you, and your approach to life. It also reflects your physical appearance and general temperament.

Name: House of Value
Meaning: The 2nd House concerns your finances, personal assets, sense of self-worth, and how you build and sustain personal security and comfort.

Name: House of Communication
Meaning: This house governs communication, thought processes, early education, neighborhood dynamics, and relationships with siblings and extended family.

Name: House of Home and Family
Meaning: The 4th House is about your roots, your sense of belonging, and your emotional base. It also represents your home life, parents (often mother), and private self.

Name: House of Pleasure
Meaning: This house is where you seek joy through personal creativity, romance, entertainment, hobbies, and the raising of children. It also governs fun and spontaneity.

Name: House of Health and Service
Meaning: The 6th House rules daily responsibilities, health and wellness, service to others, and practical skills. It also governs your relationship to work and your body’s rhythms.

Name: House of Partnerships
Meaning: This house focuses on committed relationships—romantic, business, and legal. It also shows how you relate to others in a mirrored way, including enemies.

Name: House of Transformation
Meaning: The 8th House involves deep bonding, shared finances, inheritance, personal transformation, and taboos. It represents cycles of death and rebirth in your life.

Name: House of Philosophy
Meaning: This house governs philosophy, religious and spiritual outlooks, foreign travel, and higher education. It expands your worldview through knowledge and experience.

Name: House of Career
Meaning: The 10th House reveals your highest aspirations, career path, achievements, and public image. It reflects your legacy and often parental or societal expectations.

Name: House of Community
Meaning: The 11th House governs friendships, group affiliations, collective goals, and your larger vision for humanity. It’s also linked to your hopes, dreams, and tech.

Name: House of the Subconscious
Meaning: The 12th House represents the unseen: subconscious patterns, spiritual development, dreams, solitude, institutions, and the need for retreat or healing.
